description: Update an open native Lemongraph task using its exact eight-character data.key. Accepts optional title, dueDate (YYYY-MM-DD or null), priority, and edits. Task bodies are Markdown; use Markdown formatting in new_str. Each edit replaces old_str with new_str literally, in array order. Copy old_str exactly from get_task_context task.description, including Markdown notation and whitespace; it must match once. To add text, replace a passage with itself plus the addition; use the final passage to append or the opening passage to prepend. To delete, use empty new_str. Empty old_str is allowed only for an empty body. All edits and metadata save together or none do. On a match error, reread context and use a unique passage. Omitted fields stay unchanged. External services are unchanged.

new_str.description: Replacement text. Keep the old passage to add text; use an empty string to delete.

old_str.description: Exact existing text. Must match once; empty only for an empty body.

name: update_task
title: Update task
